metric: Relative popularity (most visited) within each colour set, not search volume

source.name: Tranco
source.citation: Le Pochat et al. (2019), 'Tranco: A Research-Oriented Top Sites Ranking Hardened Against Manipulation', NDSS 2019. https://doi.org/10.14722/ndss.2019.23386
source.licence_note: Tranco aggregates Cisco Umbrella, Majestic (CC BY 3.0), Farsight, Chrome UX Report and Cloudflare Radar (CC BY-NC 4.0) rankings. Non-commercial use.

adobe.note: Possibly boosted by Creative Cloud apps contacting adobe.com in the background.

amazon.note: Merges Amazon's country stores (amazon.co.uk, amazon.de and others). Prime Video and AWS are not included.

apple.note: Likely boosted by iPhone and Mac background traffic to apple.com and icloud.com, which DNS-based rankings can't separate from real visits.

bing.note: Possibly boosted by Windows search, widgets and Edge features that contact bing.com in the background.

dzen.note: Russian news and blogging feed. Like Mail.ru, its high rank partly reflects the DNS-based sources Tranco blends in.

facebook.note: Background traffic from Facebook's SDK and image servers (facebook.net, fbcdn.net) is excluded.

fast-com.note: Netflix's speed test. Some smart TVs and apps run it in the background.

google.note: Includes Google's country sites (google.co.uk, google.de and others) and gmail.com. YouTube is counted separately.

gov-uk.note: The UK government's single website for public services.

mail-ru.note: Russian portal and email service. Ranks unusually high partly because some of Tranco's sources are DNS-based, which can favour regional giants with large resolver footprints.

microsoft.note: Likely ranked higher than real visits alone would justify: DNS-based rankings also count Windows and Office background traffic (updates, sign-ins). Merges microsoft.com, office.com, live.com, outlook.com and more.

qq.note: Tencent's portal and messaging service, hugely popular in China.

ubisoft.note: Ranked via ubi.com, which the Ubisoft Connect launcher uses.

whatsapp.note: Counts whatsapp.com and wa.me links. In-app chat traffic (whatsapp.net) is excluded.

x-twitter.note: Merges twitter.com and x.com. The t.co link shortener is excluded.

youtube.note: Includes youtu.be share links. Video streaming hosts (googlevideo.com, ytimg.com) are excluded.

zoom.note: Includes the Zoom app's own traffic to zoom.us as well as browser visits.
